finding.claim_refuted: Commit 727a1b001 cleans exact imports through aliases and barrels

input: import { brandedId } from the canonical ids module
import type { ChatId as Migrated } from the canonical ids module
import type { ChatId as StillUsed } from the canonical ids module
StillUsed remains referenced by an exported type
counterexample.expected: Migrate brandedId<Migrated>() and remove only brandedId and Migrated; retain the separately aliased StillUsed binding.
counterexample.actual: The codemod removed every ChatId import from the module and emitted `export type Kept = StillUsed;` with no StillUsed import.
counterexample.root_cause: scripts/codemods/typeid-prefix-boundaries.ts removableImports keys removals by module specifier plus exported name. Once one alias binding is removable, a second alias binding of that exported name with surviving references does not cancel the key. tooling/src/codemod/lib/imports.ts removeNamedImport then removes that exported name from every matching declaration.
